title: Run Ansible in pull mode
description: Set up a system to fetch and run playbooks automatically from a Git repository

parameters.name: repoUrl
parameters.label: Git repository URL
parameters.description: URL of the Git repository that holds the playbooks

parameters.name: playbookPath
parameters.label: Playbook

notes: Reverse pull mode: the servers fetch their configuration instead of being configured remotely. Ideal for large-scale environments.
